title: My Day
description: Practise daily routine words and the present simple, and write about your day.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write about your day in Part 2.

exercises.explanation: With he, she and it we add -s: gets.
Use "at" with clock times: at eight o'clock.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Subject + verb + thing + time: I have breakfast at seven.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Tom brush his teeth every morning.
answers: Tom brushes his teeth every morning.
exercises.explanation: He, she, it + verb with -es: brushes.

exercises.text: 🌙 I ___ go to bed late. I go at nine o'clock.
We ___ home at four o'clock after school.
exercises.explanation: We go home. "Go" fits with we.

exercises.text: I do my homework ___ the afternoon.
exercises.explanation: We say "in the morning / afternoon / evening".

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: What time do you get up?
exercises.explanation: Question word + do + you + verb: What time do you get up?

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Does Mai goes to school by bus?
answers: Does Mai go to school by bus?
exercises.explanation: After "does" use the base verb: go.

exercises.text: 🚌 My brother ___ walk to school. He goes by bus.
We ___ lunch at school at twelve o'clock.
On Saturday I get up ___ than on Monday.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Then + subject + verb: Then I wash my face.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: I go to bed on nine o'clock.
answers: I go to bed at nine o'clock.

exercises.text: I ___ dressed and then I have breakfast.

contentPoints: Say what time you get up.
Say how you go to school.
Say what you do after school.
Say what time you go to bed.
task.modelAnswer: I get up at six o'clock. I have breakfast and then I go to school by bike. School starts at seven. After school I do my homework and play with my friend Minh. I usually go to bed at nine o'clock.
